verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes REST/SQL API docs and a separate GitHub repo with OpenAPI specs plus importable Postman collections that developers can run, giving some 'runnable examples' capability, but there is no interactive in-browser API reference (Swagger/OpenAPI explorer) on docs.snowflake.com — the probe explicitly found openapi.json/swagger.json paths returning 404. missing for 10: a hosted interactive/try-it-now API console on the docs site, embedded runnable code samples in the reference pages themselves, and confirmation the Postman collections are officially maintained/kept in sync with docs.
